necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, corresponding to diagnosis code I48.0. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias. This service is medically necessary to evaluate the concern for intermittent high-grade conduction disease or rapid ventricular response.
